sections.title: Hello, my name is {{telecaller_name}}, and I am calling from Convergent, an independent research and data consulting organisation based in India. We are conducting a telephonic survey in partnership with Community Investment Management (CIM) and Dalberg Advisors to understand the experiences of individuals who applied for a loan through online or app-based lenders and received the loan, and how the application, disbursal, and repayment process can be improved. You are being contacted because your contact details were shared with us by the online lending platform(s) you applied to, through their authorised data partners TrueCredit / mPokket, solely for the purpose of independent research. This survey will take about 15–20 minutes. Your participation is completely voluntary. You may skip any question or stop the interview at any time. All information you share will be kept strictly confidential and used only for research purposes. Your responses will not affect any past, current, or future loan decisions. There are no direct risks or benefits to participating in this survey.

Hello, my name is {{telecaller_name}}, and I am calling from Convergent, an independent research and data consulting organisation based in India. We are conducting a telephonic survey in partnership with Community Investment Management (CIM) and Dalberg Advisors to understand the experiences of individuals who applied for a loan through online or app-based lenders but whose application was not approved, and how the application and rejection process can be improved. You are being contacted because your contact details were shared with us by the online lending platform(s) you applied to, through their authorised data partners TrueCredit / mPokket, solely for the purpose of independent research. This survey will take about 15–20 minutes. Your participation is completely voluntary. You may skip any question or stop the interview at any time. All information you share will be kept strictly confidential and used only for research. There are no direct risks or benefits by participating in this survey.
